findings.description: On a 360 px phone the expenses table is 760 px wide inside a main element with overflow-x: clip, and the page cannot scroll horizontally. The Amount and Actions columns are clipped off the right edge, so viewers cannot read amounts and editors cannot reach Edit or Delete.
repro: Sign in as editor-d06b (or viewer-80f9) with a 360 px wide viewport
Open /expenses
Observe the table is cut off after the Category column; the Amount and Actions columns are not visible
Try to scroll horizontally; the page does not move

findings.description: The Amount column header is right-aligned, but the amount values beneath it are left-aligned, so the header and figures do not line up.
repro: Sign in as viewer-80f9 at 1280 px
Open /expenses
Compare the Amount header (right edge of its column) with the amount values (left side of the column)

findings.description: A title made only of spaces passes the browser's required check, and the server rejects it, but the page just re-renders an empty Add expense form with no error message. The amount and category the user typed are lost and nothing is saved.
repro: Sign in as editor-d06b and open /expenses/new
Type three spaces in Title and 10 in Amount
Click Save
Observe the URL stays /expenses, the form is blank, no alert or validation message appears, and no expense is added

findings.description: The focus indicator (3 px #e09400 outline) has a contrast of about 2.3:1 against the page background and 2.5:1 against the white table, below the 3:1 expected for focus indicators.
repro: Sign in as editor-d06b at 1280 px
Press Tab until an Edit link or Delete button in the table has focus
Compare the orange focus outline with the background; it is faint against the pale teal page

findings.description: Every Delete button in the expenses table has the same accessible name, Delete, and every Edit link is named Edit, with nothing that says which expense they act on. Screen-reader users hearing the list of links and buttons cannot tell the rows apart.
repro: Sign in as editor-d06b
Open /expenses with a screen reader or accessibility tree view
List the buttons and links; all Delete buttons and all Edit links have identical names

findings.description: Clicking Delete removes the expense immediately with no confirmation and no success message. Add and Edit both show a status banner, so the delete gives no feedback at all.
repro: Sign in as editor-d06b and open /expenses
Click Delete on any row
Observe the row disappears at once, with no confirmation prompt and no 'Expense deleted' message

notes: Tested as viewer and editor at 1280, 768 and 360 px. Sign-in errors, role-based access (viewer gets 403 on /expenses/new, /expenses/:id/edit and direct POSTs to create, edit and delete), category filter totals, add/edit total recalculation and keyboard tab order all behaved correctly. Test writes were made as editor: added 'QA Test Item', 'Zero test' and 'Big test' expenses, edited 'Team lunch' to 'Team lunch (edited)' at $70, and deleted 'Printer paper'. Not reported: amounts above $999 have no thousands separator (e.g. $1234.50, $1000000.00); this is consistent across the app, so it may be intended. Not tested: screen reader output with a real AT, 320 px, zoom and reflow, and touch-specific behaviour.

cost.notes: estimate from 54413 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0005-$0.0065
